ave/host/hostFetch.description: Host-mediated outbound HTTPS through Electron's `net` (Chromium network stack). Unlike a plugin's own Node `fetch`/undici, this honors the OS proxy resolution INCLUDING PAC/WPAD auto-config and the OS trust store on every platform — so a plugin whose Node libraries can't be configured for the corporate proxy/CA (e.g. MSAL) can still reach the network on a TLS-inspecting corporate network. Capability-gated (external-auth-consumer) + SSRF-validated + audited host-side.
